Work request exists with valid workflow step at specified step number
User session is authenticated

steps.action: Navigate to checklist step view with valid work request ID and step number
steps.expected_result: Checklist step view loads successfully without permission denied message

title: Save checklist step with valid data returns success status
description: Verify that saving checklist step with valid questions and data returns QuestionsSuccess true in response body
preconditions: User is logged in with edit permissions
Checklist step exists and is in editable state
Valid questions data is prepared

steps.action: Submit POST request to OrderItem/Save with valid questions array and metadata
steps.expected_result: HTTP 200 response is returned

steps.action: Parse response body JSON and check QuestionsSuccess property
steps.expected_result: QuestionsSuccess property is true indicating successful save operation

steps.action: Verify that saved data persists by refreshing the checklist step view
steps.expected_result: Previously saved question responses are displayed correctly

title: Save checklist step silent failure detection
description: Verify that failed checklist step save operations are properly detected by checking QuestionsSuccess in response body despite HTTP 200 status
preconditions: User has access to checklist step
Scenario exists that causes save operation to fail internally

steps.action: Submit POST request to OrderItem/Save with invalid or problematic data
steps.expected_result: HTTP 200 response is returned (controller always returns 200)

steps.action: Parse response body JSON and check QuestionsSuccess property value
steps.expected_result: QuestionsSuccess property is false indicating save operation failed

steps.action: Check that failed data was not persisted by viewing checklist step
steps.expected_result: Original data remains unchanged, failed save data is not stored
